resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history. The Forest Lookouts page quotes a dated 1951 newspaper item naming lookouts. The story cites the dated item and notes the disagreement.
The Forest Lookouts page says Salmon National Forest; the Register says Salmon-Challis National Forest. The story uses the Register's name.

notes_for_editor: Built years 1919 and 1935 agree across three sources. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page carries an unsigned reader comment saying the fire was purposely set; it is unverified and left out. The 2019 photo caption is the only source on remains, and no source here covers public access. The brief's firelookout.com listing was not read. Web search budget was used up before this tower could be searched further.
